verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents GitHub/Linear integrations and webhook-triggered automations (e.g., watching PR labels, failed workflows, security alerts) that let an agent act on repo events, and issue-watching for bug triage that routes issues to owners, suggesting some issue-driven task assignment. However, no evidence explicitly shows a documented flow of assigning a coding task directly from a GitHub/Linear issue or ticket (e.g., an @openhands mention on an issue) analogous to the Slack mention flow. Missing for 10: explicit doc/example of triggering an agent from an issue/ticket (not just PR labels or Slack), and confirmation that GitHub/Linear issue-to-task assignment is a first-class supported workflow.
